name: Tag Team GX Deck Build Box

releases.name: Tag Team GX Deck Build Box

description.text: Deck Build Box TAG TEAM GX, released on 1 March 2019 with the Double Blaze expansion: ten Double Blaze packs and 158 cards of 38 kinds, 50 cards of 29 kinds proven at official tournaments, such as Tapu Lele-GX and Professor Elm's Lecture, and 108 basic Energy in the newest design, in a 750-card box, for players about to start battling seriously. Apart from the key cards its list differs from the TAG TEAM GX Premium Trainer Box, so owners of that box still gain.
